guitar.evidence: Spencer Davis played guitar in the band (Steve Winwood was keyboards/vocals); no single iconic signature instrument widely documented.
guitar.notes: Filled from unknown with low confidence.

tone.summary: A clean-to-crunch signal chain utilizing a Boost and the AC30 TB model into a suitable 4x12 cabinet to capture the bright, upper-mid focused sound of classic British R&B.
corrections: lean more Vox chime than Plexi crunch

rig.name: The Spencer Davis Group - Gimme Some Lovin' - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Provide punchy attack and slight initial drive to push the amp into desired breakup.
blocks.gap: Using Boost for controlled gain lift rather than a dedicated OD pedal, matching the 'cleaner' requirement.

alternatives.reason: A Green OD could also provide bright breakup but might be too aggressive.

blocks.purpose: Bypass or use a very subtle drive if needed; the Boost should handle most of the breakup.
blocks.gap: The target tone requires minimal distortion (edge-of-breakup), making dedicated DST modules unnecessary and potentially muddying the chime.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the bright, chimey Vox AC30 sound characteristic of classic British R&B.
Provide a classic British cabinet voicing that complements the AC30 model.
blocks.gap: While 'Vox' cabs are ideal, UK Vintage 4x12 is the closest available option for a bright, articulate British sound.

alternatives.reason: Could also work but might be slightly darker.

blocks.purpose: Enhance the upper-mid bite and brightness while keeping the low end tight.
Avoid chorus as per the 'avoid' list and keep the tone dry and punchy.
blocks.gap: The Chorus module is available but explicitly avoided by the musical verdict to maintain a tight rhythm sound.

blocks.purpose: Keep the sound focused and rhythm-oriented; delay is unnecessary.
blocks.gap: No specific ambience or time effect was requested, keeping the signal chain clean for maximum punch.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism by swapping the generic 4x12 IR for a more authentic, bright British voicing.

proposals.reason: Enhance chime and upper-mid bite specific to Vox tones.
